name: Vampire - Charm - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a action

results.text: The vampire's crimson eyes lock onto the target, a hypnotic gaze weaving through the air.
With a predatory smile, the undead beast unleashes its mesmerizing aura, filling the room with an eerie silence.
A whisper of dark enchantment escapes the vampire’s lips, the air thickening with unnatural allure.
The creature extends a skeletal hand, fingers curling as if plucking at invisible threads of will.
Eyes like pools of blood meet theirs, an inescapable pull tugging at their very soul.
